title: TICKET-036-WS1 — Gemma 4 26B MoE Benchmark on Mac Mini (ClawRouter Tier Evaluation)
description: TICKET-036 Workstream 1: Benchmark Gemma 4 26B MoE against qwen3:14b on Mac Mini M4 for ClawRouter POWER tier. Three representative agent tasks (dev/QA/audit). Measure tokens/sec, TTFT, peak memory, output quality. Test function calling and system instruction adherence. Source: TICKET-036.

tasks.title: Create Gemma 4 vs Qwen3:14b benchmark harness script
tasks.context:
Create a TypeScript benchmark script that tests two Ollama models (gemma4:26b and qwen3:14b) on three tasks. The script should:

1. DEV TASK: Send a prompt asking each model to generate a Python FastAPI endpoint with structured error handling. Score output quality 1-5 on completeness, correctness, code style.
2. QA TASK: Send a deliberately buggy Python script and ask each model to find and fix all bugs. Score detection accuracy and fix quality 1-5.
3. AUDIT TASK: Send a regulatory document excerpt and ask each model to extract structured JSON data. Score accuracy and JSON compliance 1-5.

For each task, measure:
- tokens_per_second (output tokens / generation time)
- time_to_first_token_ms
- peak_memory_mb (query Ollama /api/ps endpoint)
- output_quality (placeholder for human rating)

Use the Ollama HTTP API at localhost:11434. Store results as JSON in workspace/benchmarks/gemma4-benchmark-results.json.

Do NOT use any npm packages beyond node built-ins (fetch, fs). Keep the script self-contained.

tasks.title: Create function calling compliance test for Gemma 4 vs Qwen
tasks.context:
Create a TypeScript script that tests function calling (tool use) compliance for Gemma 4 26B MoE and qwen3:14b via Ollama API.

Define 5 test cases:
1. Simple single tool call (get_weather with city param)
2. Multi-step tool call (search_db then format_result)
3. Structured JSON output (generate PACT offer schema)
4. System instruction adherence (agent persona + constraints, check if model follows)
5. x402 payment header generation (produce valid x402 JSON)

For each test, check:
- Did the model produce valid JSON tool calls?
- Did it follow the schema exactly?
- How many retries needed to get valid output?

Store results in workspace/benchmarks/gemma4-function-calling-results.json with pass/fail per test and compliance rate percentage.
